verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a SaaS project-management product with a public REST API and plan-gated Automations, so the question of what happens on exceeding limits applies. The pack does not document API rate limits, automation quotas, overage charges, throttling behavior, or hard stops. The only 'limits' mentioned are workflow-state story (WIP) limits, which are an unrelated feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know what happens—extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop—when I exceed my plan's automation or API call limits
